name: Call of Earth
summary: At Kodo Rock, you seek communion with earth through a sacred tauren rite. Drinking an Earth Sapta lets you see a Minor Manifestation of Earth.

sections.title: The Purpose of the Sapta
sections.body: Shamanic elders brew a sapta to bind an initiate’s mortal spirit to a primal element. Ancestral magic guards the brewing secrets, known to only a select few among the tauren. Drink the draught at a sacred site, and your mind opens beyond the physical world. The veil parts, and the elements can be witnessed in their raw form.

sections.title: Communion at Kodo Rock
sections.body: East of Camp Narache, Kodo Rock rises as a stone pillar and holy sanctuary. Drink the sapta there, and a Minor Manifestation of Earth appears before you. Along the shaman’s path, other aspects of nature are volatile, fiery, or raging. Earth asks for quiet humility instead. Honor the land, and its spirit grants you the mountain’s enduring strength and the plains’ calm patience.

faq.answer: An Earth Sapta is a ceremonial draught brewed by shamanic elders. Its magic opens your perception so you can see and speak with elemental earth spirits.
Kodo Rock is a natural stone monolith east of Camp Narache, across the Red Cloud Mesa.

faq.q: Who crafted the Earth Sapta for this rite?
faq.answer: Seer Ravenfeather, an elder shaman at Camp Narache, prepared and granted the potion. Seer Ravenfeather oversees the training of young spiritual guides.

faq.q: Why must the sapta be consumed at a holy site?
faq.answer: Tauren tradition calls for a sapta to be drunk only in a consecrated shrine, where elemental spirits dwell and can receive the petitioner safely. The draught is sacred and dangerous if misused.

faq.q: What happens after drinking the potion at Kodo Rock?
faq.answer: Drinking the potion at Kodo Rock lifts the mundane veil and reveals a Minor Manifestation of Earth. Speaking with the spirit completes the shaman’s bond with earth.

faq.q: What lesson does the earth spirit impart to initiates?
faq.answer: The earth spirit teaches humble patience, not combat. Fire and air can be chaotic and violent, while earth offers strength, endurance, and a quiet foundation for the shaman’s soul.

angles.text: As a shaman, this rite forms the spiritual core of your bond with the land. It is the bridge to communion with earth and to receiving an Earth Totem.
As a tauren, you can take part in the sapta ritual, one of the most revered coming-of-age tests for spiritualists on the Red Cloud Mesa.
